app.name: SortVision
app.one_liner: An interactive web application that visualizes sorting algorithms in real time with customizable parameters and performance metrics.

screens.name: Algorithm Visualization Dashboard
screens.purpose: Display real-time animation of selected sorting algorithm with controls for customization and performance feedback.

rust_commands.name: save_item
rust_commands.purpose: Persist user configuration or session state (e.g., preferred algorithm, array settings).

mvp_plan: week 1: Build responsive UI with algorithm selector and playback controls
week 1: Implement core visualization engine for at least 3 sorting algorithms
week 1: Integrate performance metric tracking (comparisons, swaps)
acceptance_tests: Adjusting speed slider immediately affects animation frame rate without breaking visualization.
User can select Bubble Sort and observe correct step-by-step execution on a randomized array.
